question: Who authored the book ‘PMO: Prime Minister’s Office through the Years’ that was released in May 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Himanshu Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Himanshu Roy** authored the book "**PMO: Prime Minister's Office through the Years**", which was released in **May 2025**.
 
• The book provides an in-depth analysis of the evolution and functioning of the **Prime Minister's Office (PMO)** in India.
 
• It examines the role of the PMO in shaping **policy decisions**, managing **crises**, and interacting with various government departments and ministries.
 
• The book is a significant contribution to understanding the **political and administrative structure** of India.
 
• Himanshu Roy</s
